query: Notification obligation regarding rectification or erasure of personal data or restriction of processing
response: According to Article 19 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the controller is obligated to notify each recipient who has received personal data about any rectification or erasure of that data, or restriction on processing. This notification must be carried out in accordance with Articles 16, 17(1) and 18 of the GDPR. However, this obligation may not apply if it is impossible to inform a recipient or would involve disproportionate effort. Additionally, controllers are required to inform data subjects about those recipients who have received their personal data upon request by the subject.
